proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent-supplied proof of dmcbr_closure_succ ("multiplication by ζ preserves test-form convergence and maps into 𝒟^n(U)"), proved in full. Sibling dependency: LEIB = dmcbrcs_norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le (key smul_leibniz): for C^∞ f : ℝ^P → ℝ and g : ℝ^P → Λ^k(ℝ^P), ‖D^n(f·g)(x)‖ ≤ Σ_{i=0}^{n} C(n,i)‖D^i f(x)‖‖D^{n−i} g(x)‖. Notation: D^l = iteratedFDeriv ℝ l with the operator norm.
1. (Data.) By hypothesis there is a compact K′ with tsupport ω_j ⊆ K′ for all j and, for each l ∈ ℕ, D^l ω_j → D^l 0 uniformly on K′. The underlying form of the zero test form (in any domain) is the zero function, and D^l 0 = 0 (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero). Since η_j(x) = ζ(x)•ω_j(x) for all x, η_j = ζ·ω_j as functions.
2. (The compact set.) Let K₂ := tsupport ζ. It is compact (ζ has compact support) and K₂ ⊆ U. For every j, tsupport η_j = tsupport(ζ·ω_j) ⊆ tsupport ζ = K₂ (tsupport_smul_subset_left), and tsupport of the zero form is tsupport 0 = ∅ ⊆ K₂ (tsupport_fun_zero). So the support conditions of TestFormOnConverges ηs 0 hold with K₂; it remains to show D^i η_j → D^i 0 = 0 uniformly on K₂ for each i.
3. (Bounds for ζ.) For each l, D^l ζ is continuous (ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv, ζ being C^∞) and has compact support (HasCompactSupport.iteratedFDeriv), hence is bounded (Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support): there is B_l ∈ ℝ with ‖D^l ζ(x)‖ ≤ B_l ≤ |B_l| for all x.
4. (Global smallness of the ω_j.) Let l ∈ ℕ and ε > 0. By uniform convergence on K′ (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff, with D^l 0 = 0), for all large j we have ‖D^l ω_j(x)‖ < ε for every x ∈ K′. If x ∉ K′ then x ∉ tsupport ω_j ⊇ tsupport(D^l ω_j) (tsupport_iteratedFDeriv_subset), so D^l ω_j(x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport) and ‖D^l ω_j(x)‖ = 0 < ε. Hence for all large j, ‖D^l ω_j(x)‖ < ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
5. (Uniform convergence of D^i η_j.) Fix i ∈ ℕ and ε > 0, and put S := Σ_{l=0}^{i} C(i,l)|B_l| + 1 > 0. Applying step 4 to the finitely many orders i − l, l ∈ {0, …, i}, with ε/S (Filter.eventually_all_finset), for all large j we have ‖D^{i−l} ω_j(x)‖ < ε/S for all l ≤ i and all x. For such j and every x (in particular every x ∈ K₂), LEIB with f := ζ, g := ω_j (ω_j is C^∞ as a test form) gives ‖D^i η_j(x) − D^i 0(x)‖ = ‖D^i(ζ·ω_j)(x)‖ ≤ Σ_{l=0}^{i} C(i,l)‖D^l ζ(x)‖‖D^{i−l} ω_j(x)‖ ≤ Σ_{l=0}^{i} C(i,l)|B_l|·(ε/S) = (S − 1)(ε/S) < ε. So D^i η_j → D^i 0 uniformly on K₂.
6. (Conclusion.) K₂ is a compact subset of U containing every tsupport η_j and tsupport 0, and every derivative converges uniformly on K₂ (step 5). Hence TestFormOnConverges ηs 0 in U. ∎

theorem Submission.dmcbrcs_testFormOnConverges_smul : ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn U k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → (∀ j x, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = ζ x • (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) → TestFormOnConverges ηs 0 := by
  have hL := Submission.dmcbrcs_norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le
  intro P k U ζ ωs ηs hζ hζc hζU hconv hη
  obtain ⟨K', -, -, hsupp, -, hunif⟩ := hconv
  have hηfun : ∀ j, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) =
      fun y => ζ y • (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) y := fun j => funext (hη j)
  have hzero : ∀ (V : Set (Euclid P)) (l : ℕ) (x : Euclid P),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (((0 : TestFormOn V k)) : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = 0 := by
    intro V l x
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun _ => (0 : Covector (Euclid P) k)) x = 0
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]; rfl
  refine ⟨tsupport ζ, hζc, hζU, fun j => ?_, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [hηfun j]
    exact tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _
  · change tsupport (fun _ => (0 : Covector (Euclid P) k)) ⊆ tsupport ζ
    rw [tsupport_fun_zero]; exact empty_subset _
  have hB : ∀ l : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l ζ x‖ ≤ B := fun l =>
    (hζ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).bounded_above_of_compact_support
      (hζc.iteratedFDeriv l)
  choose B hB using hB
  have hsmall : ∀ l : ℕ, ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ x,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x‖ < ε := by
    intro l ε hε
    filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 (hunif l) ε hε] with j hj x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K'
    · have h := hj x hx
      rw [hzero, dist_zero_left] at h
      exact h
    · have hx' : x ∉ tsupport (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) :=
        fun h => hx (hsupp j (tsupport_iteratedFDeriv_subset l h))
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx', norm_zero]
      exact hε
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
  intro ε hε
  set S : ℝ := ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ) * |B l| + 1 with hS_def
  have hS : 0 < S := by positivity
  have hev : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), ∀ x,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - l) (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x‖ < ε / S := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
    intro l _
    exact hsmall (i - l) (ε / S) (div_pos hε hS)
  filter_upwards [hev] with j hj x _
  rw [hzero, dist_zero_left, hηfun j]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (hL P k ζ _ hζ (ωs j).property.1.1 i x) ?_
  calc ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l ζ x‖ *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - l) (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x‖
      ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ) * |B l| * (ε / S) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun l hl => ?_
        have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l ζ x‖ ≤ |B l| := (hB l x).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have h2 := (hj l hl x).le
        have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i.choose l : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg hc (abs_nonneg _))
    _ = (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ) * |B l|) * (ε / S) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ < S * (ε / S) := by
        apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ (div_pos hε hS)
        rw [hS_def]; linarith
    _ = ε := by field_simp

key_steps: Unpack TestFormOnConverges ωs 0: compact K′ and uniform convergence of every derivative on K′; D^l 0 = 0.
Use K₂ := tsupport ζ (compact, ⊆ U); tsupport η_j ⊆ K₂.
Derivatives of ζ are bounded (continuous with compact support).
Derivatives of ω_j vanish off K′, so they tend to 0 uniformly on all of ℝ^P.
Leibniz (sibling) bounds ‖D^i(ζω_j)‖ by Σ C(i,l)|B_l|·sup‖D^{i−l}ω_j‖ → 0, uniformly in x.
